title: 12 第12章 双绝13 第13章 雷动
content_zh:
林轩感到一阵头晕，等到恢复神智时，发现他又回到了小屋中。
低声咒骂了几句，他拿出了摘到的三株阴行草。
将其中一株用灵力碾碎，提取出其中的液体，随后他又拿出了那受损的人级宝器。
将阴行草的液体滴到人级宝器之上，林轩有用鲜血化成了一个奇特符文。
顿时，那团褐色的东西很快融化，然后滴落到地上，那地面被烧成一个又一个小洞。
最后，人级宝器上面再也没有污染物，林轩在剑身上画出三个符文，引来空气中的灵力来洗伐剑身。
“嗯，手法还不错，不过还是有点稚嫩。”
酒爷的声音在林轩心底响起。
“你懂养器之法？”
林轩撇撇嘴。
“那是，想当年我可是被称为双绝，一是酒绝，而是剑绝。
凡是和剑有关的，没有我不会的。
修剑什么的，太简单了！”
“剑绝！”
林轩眼睛一亮，“既然说的这么厉害，拿个高级剑法给我练练。”
“我这的剑法等级都太高，现在你根本修炼不了，等级突破灵海境再说吧。”
酒爷说完这些，便沉寂下来。
林轩恨得牙痒痒，不过任凭他怎么喊都么有回应。
这个时候，那些闪烁的符文也消失。
而剑身之上，泛着淡淡的光辉，隔着老远就能感受到上面的冷意。

“不愧是宝器，没用灵力催动，就有如此的威力！
“林轩感受到剑身上传来的刺骨寒意，心中满是赞叹。
宝器，是超越了普通刀剑的兵器。
它们的内部都铭刻了特殊的符文，武者将灵力灌注到其中，能爆发出超越本身实力的力量。
每一把宝器都是十分珍贵的，是由炼器师们精心打造出来的，每个武者都梦想能拥有一把宝器级武器。
把修复好的宝器放好，林轩心中不免有些激动。
等明天提交完任务，他就有一百贡献点了，再加上之前的任务，他一共有一百三十点贡献点，外加七十块下品灵石。
一百点贡献点足够兑换一门黄阶低级武学了，而那下品灵石也可以购买东西，或者直接吸收里面的灵力，不过下品灵石所含的灵力比较斑杂，需要自身提纯。
第二天一早，林轩扛着长木盒就直奔任务堂。
碰！
他将木盒放到登记弟子面前，笑嘻嘻的说道：“师兄，验一下货吧！”
那登记弟子半信半疑的瞥了一眼林轩，然后快速的打开了长木盒。
三尺青锋，泛着幽光，隐隐透发出一股刺骨的寒意，仿佛随时都能爆发出强大的威力。
“这……”
登记弟子深吸一口冷气，然后狠狠的吞了吞口水。
“没错，真修好了！”
登记弟子一脸震惊的说道，“师弟还真是厉害！”
他当初让林轩接这个任务只是抱着试一下的态度，他自己都没有报什么希望，没想到林轩竟然真的修好了！
登记弟子快速的将奖励发给林轩，然后将宝器收好。
林轩从所得的灵石中拿出二十块灵石，分给了登记弟子。

“师兄，以后还要你多多照顾，要是再有什么修复兵器之类的任务，师兄帮我留着。”
林轩笑眯眯的说道。
content_en:
Lin Xuan felt dizzy. When he regained consciousness, he found that he was back in the hut.
Cursing a few times under his breath, he took out the three Yinxingcao plants he had picked.
He crushed one of them with spiritual power and extracted the liquid. Then he took out the damaged human-level treasure.
Lin Xuan dripped the liquid of Yinxingcao onto the human-level treasure, and Lin Xuan turned the blood into a strange rune.
Suddenly, the brown stuff melted quickly, and then dripped to the ground, and the ground was burned into small holes one after another.
Finally, there were no more pollutants on the human-level treasure. Lin Xuan drew three runes on the sword, attracting the spiritual power in the air to cleanse the sword.
"Well, the technique is pretty good, but it's still a bit immature."
The wine master's voice sounded in Lin Xuan's heart.
"Do you know how to maintain a weapon?"
Lin Xuan pouted.
“That’s right, I think back then I was called a double master, one was wine master, and the other was sword master.
I can't do anything related to swords.
Sword repair and all that, it’s so easy! "
"Jian Jue!"
Lin Xuan's eyes lit up, "Since you are so powerful, give me some advanced sword skills to practice."
"The level of my swordsmanship is too high. Now you can't practice it at all. You won't be able to do it until you reach the level of the spiritual sea."
After the wine master said this, he fell silent.
Lin Xuan's teeth were itching with hatred, but no matter how much he shouted, there was no response.
At this time, those flashing runes also disappeared.
There was a faint glow on the sword body, and the coldness on it could be felt from a long distance away.
"It is indeed a treasure. It has such power without the use of spiritual power!
"Lin Xuan felt the biting coldness coming from the sword, and his heart was full of admiration.
A treasure weapon is a weapon that transcends ordinary swords.
Special runes are engraved inside them. When warriors pour spiritual power into them, they can explode with power beyond their own strength.
Every treasure weapon is very precious and is carefully crafted by weapon refiners. Every warrior dreams of owning a treasure-level weapon.
Putting the repaired treasure away, Lin Xuan couldn't help but feel a little excited.
After submitting the task tomorrow, he will have one hundred contribution points. Adding the previous tasks, he will have a total of one hundred and thirty contribution points, plus seventy low-grade spiritual stones.
One hundred contribution points are enough to exchange for a yellow-level low-level martial arts, and the low-grade spiritual stones can also be used to buy things, or directly absorb the spiritual power inside. However, the spiritual power contained in low-grade spiritual stones is more complex and needs to be purified by oneself.
Early the next morning, Lin Xuan went straight to the mission hall carrying the long wooden box.
bump!
He placed the wooden box in front of the registered disciples and said with a smile: "Brother, let's inspect the goods!"
The registered disciple glanced at Lin Xuan doubtfully, and then quickly opened the long wooden box.
The three-foot green front was glowing with light and faintly sending out a biting chill, as if it could explode with powerful power at any time.
"This..."
The registered disciple took a deep breath of cold air, and then swallowed hard.
"That's right, it's really fixed!"
The registered disciple said with a shocked expression, "Junior brother is really amazing!"
When he asked Lin Xuan to take on this task, he just wanted to give it a try. He didn't even have any hope, but he didn't expect Lin Xuan to actually fix it!
The registered disciple quickly gave the reward to Lin Xuan, and then put the treasure away.
Lin Xuan took out twenty spiritual stones from the obtained spiritual stones and distributed them to the registered disciples.
"Senior brother, I need you to take more care of me in the future. If there are any other tasks like repairing weapons, senior brother will keep it for me."
Lin Xuan said with a smile.
